Experiment 046, mixed_a_c064 and mixed_b_c064: 128 requests total, 128 generated tokens each (reasoning and answer tokens), temperature 0, 15 ms arrival spacing; 12 prompt families. decodeTps is the arithmetic mean of two phase rates over shared decode intervals across 64 concurrent stream(s); observed phase range 53.454772-53.743871 tok/s. Deterministic prompts recur and phrase learning stays enabled. Capture writes were enabled on ascending 1-15 stream phases and disabled thereafter. Completed runs only; interrupted attempts are excluded and documented in the evidence. runDate uses America/Chicago. The 128-token cap is below the site recommendation of 256.
